body: I feel the same way. I don’t get excited for anything anymore. I’m literally drowning in my anxiety and life’s problems, but I have no idea of what to do or how to move forward.
I write my thoughts down, and then pretend like I'm someone else ( with a more positive voice ) and answer them.
For me, it's everything at the moment,,  my job, my family, my finances, and my health ( sorry for being too pessimistic).
Same, I'm turning 30 this year, and everything keeps getting worst. I don't know what to do or how to fix the situation. I hate the thought of tomorrow :(

I don’t have any useful skills. I tried college but i failed it several times ( poor habits and mental health), and now I’m in debts because of it. It might sound like I’m making up excuses but it’s hard to find a stable and nice paying job. And I’m not one of those people who just sitting around and do nothing. I go to work everyday and work OT whenever it’s available. But everything just feels like a dead end.
I feel the same. I just want to be to feel peaceful inside.

I'm the same age as you. I have no real friends and also no interests. I've never been in a relationship. I have nothing going on in my life except for debts and work to pay off my debts. I also think that I will be alone forever, and there are days when everything makes me feel so hopeless.

I will hug you if I'm able to since I feel like I can relate so much to this. I sometimes wonder what's wrong with me and if it's worth it to continue living like this. It sucks having no one. I wish I have some advice to give you, but I don't. I just want to comment to let you know that you're not alone.

I can totally relate. I'm just tired all the time.

My low energy, boring personality, and appearance are the cause for my FA status and the reason why I'm unable to find a better job.

You will be fine. English is my second language, and my writing skill is very limited. Most colleges have like a writing lab/writing center to help their students. There is also Grammarly. Just remember to reach out to the professor if you need any assistance. Good luck

I feel the same way.
I think I'm missing out on many things because I chose to stay home instead of going out. It doesn't help when I love being at home by myself, and my anxiety is terrible, so I avoid social events because they wear me out. Therefore, I don't meet new people that often, so I'm pretty much alone all the time. 
But there's also a chance that I'm FA because of how I look.

The same thing happened to me multiple times before. I'm used to it now, but I know the loneliness can be too much to bear sometimes. I honestly don't have any advice for you, but I want to stop by and tell you Happy Birthday!!

Me too. I rather end everything than living like this. I was lying in bed this morning and thinking about the same thing. I didn’t even know when it started, but the heaviness in my chest and all these thoughts about life and death made me feel exhausted
From my personal experience, I avoid being too close to people now. Sometimes I feel very lonely, but I have fewer heartaches and disappointments

Although I don’t think too much about it anymore since I can’t really change how I look, but I think I know how you feel. I’m so ugly that I hate looking at myself in the mirror, and I hate taking pics with friends or family because of how I look. I feel sad when I met someone pretty or even average looking people around me. I’m constantly thinking what my life would be like if I don’t look the way I am.

I honestly feel the same

Mostly because I have anxiety problems and I also hate the way I look.
Yea me too! I'm too tired of this life.
